actor: mk — solo gardener, diving into one garden for an hour or an evening
trigger: The daily walk (or a popup-class interrupt) lands attention on one garden: something waits on them, or a thread wants pulling

steps.step: Enter the garden from the door — switch-client into its tmux session, or start one
Orient conversationally before working: interrogate what predecessor sessions found and left unfinished, seance-style, instead of re-deriving context
build_surface: cass session archives (~2205 conversations) or a per-repo events ledger (substrate open)

steps.step: Play in the world — terminals, Zed, salons; the HUD stays out of the way while the work happens where it lives
build_surface: none — deliberately; the HUD overlays, it does not contain the work

steps.step: Steer long-running agent work as situations with progress and a re-selectable approach, not as a popup stream — retune mid-flight without restarting
Delegate with honest scope: intent-level instructions with hand-pruned exclusions and narrow permissions — trust is earned per-scope, never assumed
Land the plane: a parking ritual that captures state to the ledger — cards, beads, commits — so the next walk's briefing can be true

mental_model: The dive is the play half of the loop — 'one gardens different planets and systems.' A dive begins from stillness (orientation is a conversation with the past, not a scroll-back) and ends with ritual (parking is a structured act, not a habit that decays under fatigue). Work state lives in the ledger, never in a coordinator or a context window — the session is ephemeral, the garden persists. Delegation that cannot be trusted is theater; mk would rather a narrow honest scope than a broad lying one.

closed_decisions: Entry is tmux switch-client from the door (shipped and playtested)
Parking is a ritual, not a habit — the close-out is structured (Gas Town's Landing the Plane; mk's session-completion protocol is the same instinct)
Delegation without trust is theater: intent-declaration interfaces ship with honest, hand-pruned scope (Stellaris E as cautionary tale + the untrustable-autopilot resentment)
The coordinator holds no state — session state lives in cards/beads/git on disk

open_questions.question: What is the minimum viable parking ritual — a card touch, a bead update, an auto-generated timeline entry, or all three?
What substrate does seance-style orientation read — cass archives, a per-repo .events.jsonl, or transcript search?
Is the in-Autarch tending pane (huh + glamour + Composer, parts list researched) part of the dive or a separate surface?

The dive as observed is a standing thread — 15 of 16 August dives were estate-scoped thematic conversations alive 2-4 weeks (median 58 turns, ~10 active hours), reaching into many gardens and never parking; the living thread is its own seance. Does landing-the-plane apply per sitting, per thread-death (pre-compaction canon capture), or only to fleet jobs — and is this CUJ's spine the garden-entry or the thread?

implied_features: Seance-style orientation on enter: query predecessor sessions for findings and unfinished work
Landing-the-plane close-out prompt wired to cards/beads/commit state
Situation log for long-running agents: progress plus re-selectable approach, replacing popup streams

implied_features.feature: Tending pane for in-HUD card editing (huh v1.0.0 + glamour + Composer)
implied_features.phase: after CUJ derive — mk ruled 'shouldn't we map out CUJs for Autarch first?'

reference_lineage.what_it_shaped: Seance (conversational orientation), Landing the Plane (parking ritual), ledger-not-context-window state, capacity-governed dispatch
Pairs A (begin from stillness), D (situations with approaches), E (delegation-by-intent as cautionary tale)
Structured Boundaries (arrival, work, departure) and Calibrated Autonomy (graduated trust, not binary)

evidence.quote: i honestly think the real time pause 4x style of game that stellaris, where one gardens different planets and systems is probably closest to what i think i should be doing
evidence.assumption_tested: That deep work needs the tool to contain it — the RTwP frame says the tool's job is entry, steering, and exit around work that happens in the world
That the dive is obligation-shaped — mk framed it as play; flow is load-bearing, and dev software failing at flow was the discover stage's founding observation

evidence.quote: hmm check my sessions to determine how I actually work
evidence.assumption_tested: That the dive enters one garden and parks on exit — observed: dives are standing threads with pace-layered revisit cadences (four daily companions, five every-2-3-days, one weekly), and no parking behavior exists; the ritual is a designed correction to the losing-the-thread failure, not a current habit

success_condition: mk enters a garden cold after two weeks and is working within minutes because the orientation told them what the last session knew — and when they leave, the parking ritual means nothing lives only in their head; they recognize the enter–play–park shape as how they already want to work, not a process imposed on them.
